assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only 86-eighty-six:kurena-kukumila@original-light-novels#86-kurena-kukumila-character-reference-profile, the canonical CMR-4 Kurena Kukumila character reference profile (version 1.2, release 86-V2-V01-V14-1.0) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked original-Japanese light novels V01-V14, with Alter.1 as audited supplemental ordinary-life evidence and Alter.2 excluded. The project's corpus map, the Character Modeling Reference method and the profile's own validation report were read for method, authority order and scope only. The ledgers L01, L02 and L09, Documents 04, 09, 12 and 16, the relationship matrix, the diagnostic index, the CMR-9 audit, the Phase-5 and Phase-8 artifacts and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, and nothing is borrowed from them. The profile's CMR-9 verdict and its HIGH, MODERATE and OPEN labels are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation, V15+ volume, Alter.2 scene or other character's profile is included, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The profile's phases from V01 (attachment, anger and perceptive care) through V14 (real growth meeting the unresolved standard that strength means successful rescue). V06 is split at the recognition inside her request to Shin (Shinei Nouzen) (p-005 ¶220); V07 at the non-entitlement recognition (p-009 ¶242); V08 at the collapse (p-011 ¶194-196); V09 at the shutdown (p-004 ¶280-281), the restored trust and recovered memory (p-008 ¶341-429) and the confession (p-013 ¶3-20); V11 at the fear revision (p-018 ¶259-268); and V14 at Rito's death and her grief (p-005 ¶115-129). V02-V05 and V11-V12 are otherwise grouped phases, and V10 has only ordinary-life rows. No default state is set; one must be selected. Alter.1 rows are ordinary-life supplements without volume placement, and states after V14 are not established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The profile gives a causal account of Kurena (Kurena Kukumila): when she cannot act, protect or contribute, she is at risk of becoming again the powerless child who could not stop her parents' murder and her sister being taken (V09 p-008 ¶304-319; V11 p-018 ¶262). It pairs this with a located negative control: her original marksmanship was not a way to stay useful enough to be kept beside Shin (Shinei Nouzen), but an offer to share the pain of his mercy killings (V09 p-008 ¶403-429). The model says what changes her response: whether action is possible, whether a loved person is moving beyond her reach, whether concern implies she is already defeated, whether a child or powerless person is threatened, and whether a failure is ordinary professional disappointment or a failure to protect that touches the wound. It separates shame (withdrawal and food refusal, V09 p-004 ¶280-281) from a threat to dignity (sharp rejection of pity, V03 p-005 ¶317-332). It predicts her mistakes: pressing Shin not to change while recognizing the demand inside her own care (V06 p-005 ¶213-222), widening one person or one loss into a general conclusion under pressure (early hostility to Lena (Vladilena Milizé); V08 p-004 ¶342-345; V14 p-005 ¶123), and reading a failed rescue as proof her strength was false. A would overclaim: the set is one derived artifact that defers to L01, L02, L09 and Documents 04 and 09 outside it, T14-OQ-23 (her independent worth) stays open, and every sampled recovery from failed protection involves another person's intervention. C would understate an account that discriminates action, distance, pity, age and failure type and predicts her errors with their located corrections.

The profile gives an ordered developmental account of Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) with located turning points: V06 recognition that 'you need not change' means 'do not change' (p-005 ¶220); V07 recognition that the romantic place beside Shin (Shinei Nouzen) is not hers (p-009 ¶242-247); V08 collapse when Shin seems lost (p-011 ¶194-196); V09 shutdown (p-004 ¶280-281), restored command trust (p-008 ¶341-381), the recovered origin memory (¶403-429) and the confession that she still loves him (p-013 ¶3-20); V11 fear revision toward the Republic (p-018 ¶259-268) and protection of Alba children (p-022 ¶365-382); V13 command (p-003 ¶58-88; p-006 ¶475-478); and the V14 sequence from ordinary life (p-004) to grief after Rito's death (p-005 ¶115-129) to precision command (p-008 ¶45-49, ¶354). It forbids two retrojections explicitly: V08 does not prove V07 growth fake, and V14 breakdown does not prove earlier growth failed. C would understate located, causally ordered transitions with these controls. A is rejected: V02-V05 and V11-V12 are grouped phases and V10 has no trajectory entry, V03, V04 and V10 have three, two and two rows, the profile names no default state, and nothing after V14 is established.

The profile gives a functional Japanese fingerprint for Kurena (Kurena Kukumila): dominant あたし in every state, with no shift toward 私 as a sign of maturity; emotional permeability through repetition (そんなの、いいわけないでしょ！, V09 p-004 ¶310), stretched endings and childlike denial (もん), and plain affect words (怖い, 悲しい, 悔しい). It states rules by state: under pressure a concise, confident combat register (任せて; the V14 hand-off to Raiden (Raiden Shuga), p-008 ¶354); vulnerability that becomes younger rather than literary (V08 おいていかないで, p-011 ¶194; V09 平気なわけ──ないじゃない; V14 守れなかった); insight kept in concrete bodily and social images rather than theory; and address that varies by relation (シン; early あんた toward Lena (Vladilena Milizé) becoming レーナ; plain names for peers). There are 38 would-sound-wrong constraints. For illustrative textual Japanese with sampled peers in sampled states, C would understate it. A is rejected: there is no frequency or distribution; exemplars are not classified by focalization as the project method requires; several exemplars in the voice and humor sections (ちっちゃい妹じゃないもーん, ふふーんだ, 任せて。ばっちりぴったり送ってあげる) carry no locator; address toward superiors and the forms of her command register are not given; and the L09 voice ledger is outside the set.

The profile treats ordinary life as central for Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) and locates it across the corpus in 28 ordinary-tagged rows: card games (V01 p-008 ¶18), window-shopping after rescue (V02 p-006 ¶77), claiming the boys as 'my side' after Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) teases her (V06 p-005 ¶86), bathhouse comparison jokes (V07 p-006 ¶151-157), party dress and dancing with Shiden (Shiden Iida) (V07 p-009 ¶245, ¶420), setting dishes and rolling in the grass (V10 p-025 ¶24; p-027 ¶66), accepting study advice from Anju (Anju Emma) (V12 p-004 ¶168), daily slogan lettering and a shopping group (V14 p-004 ¶88-90), a childhood anime theme (V14 p-007 ¶567), and Alter.1 mending and birthdays. Some patterns are conditioned: she reciprocates a gift at once by asking Lena's (Vladilena Milizé's) birthday, mending is not her skill and becomes a way to be near Shin (Shinei Nouzen), and she resists being frozen as the little sister. B would overclaim: the ordinary-life section is a list, the profile does not say what decides her ordinary choices beyond open affect and competition, there is no routine, sequence or frequency, and the Alter.1 rows are not placed by volume. D would understate recurring, located ordinary conduct from V01 to V14 with conditioned patterns.

Nine directed relations from Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) are analyzed and distinguished. Shin (Shinei Nouzen) moves from attraction with moral attention (V01 p-012 ¶106-119) to skill, proximity and stasis entangled (V05 p-006 ¶374-378; V06 p-005 ¶206-222) to durable love with a relinquished exclusive claim (V09 p-013 ¶3-20). Lena (Vladilena Milizé) moves from intrusion and anti-Alba hostility (V01 p-008 ¶59-69) to teasing friendship and gifts (Alter.1). Theo (Theoto Rikka) is the safe peer for uncertainty that needs no solution, outside romance and hierarchy (V08 p-006 ¶70-76; V14 p-005 ¶115-129). Anju (Anju Emma) becomes someone Kurena supports in turn (V13 p-005 ¶681-685). Raiden (Raiden Shuga) is a sibling-like tactical partner (V14 p-008 ¶45-49, ¶354). Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) is a younger household member, Shiden (Shiden Iida) a former rival she can dance with, the younger Eighty-Six and Rito are people she expected to protect, and Republic people are protected without being forgiven. C would understate this partner-specific discrimination. A is rejected: Frederica, Shiden, Rito and Gilwiese rest on one to three rows each; Grethe (Grethe Wenzel) and other superiors are not profiled one to one; post-V09 exchanges with Shin are few and the Alter.1 closeness rows are unplaced; and the relationship matrix and L02 are outside the set.

Kurena's (Kurena Kukumila's) private states are located at several points: early reflection on a relational limit (V01 p-012 ¶115-117), recognition inside her own request to Shin (Shinei Nouzen) (V06 p-005 ¶220), the boundary she reaffirms at the party (V07 p-009 ¶242-247), the belief that her place exists only beside Shin (V08 p-011 ¶196), the usefulness fear and an inner accusation that calls her a powerless child (V09 p-008 ¶304-319), admitting to herself that she is afraid to kill and rejecting the usefulness origin (¶416-429), and the V14 equation of failed rescue with failed strength (p-005 ¶123). These states drive located choices: the V09 recovery and confession, and the V14 grief. The profile adds that she often understands a contradiction in her feeling before she can live through it. C would understate rendered interior logic causally linked to conduct from V06 to V14. A is rejected: exemplars are not classified as dialogue, inner speech or focalized narration; the V11 and V14 interior is largely spoken self-disclosure (in V14, to Theo (Theoto Rikka)); V02-V05 interior is thin; and T14-OQ-23 leaves her deepest priority after V14 open.

Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) confronts rather than qualifies, and the profile states the classes: refusing pity that defines her as defeated (V03 p-005 ¶317-332), refusing to yield her sniper role (V06 p-005 ¶43), confronting grief minimization (V09 p-004 ¶306-310 with Mica), and interrupting a former Eighty-Six Shepherd about to repeat persecution on Alba children (V11 p-022 ¶365-382). It states her weakness as scope under emotional pressure (Lena (Vladilena Milizé) standing for every 白ブタ in V01; uncertainty about the future becoming 'there is no future'; one loss becoming proof of powerlessness) and her development as keeping the feeling while narrowing the conclusion. It separates confrontation under a dignity threat from withdrawal under shame, and shows her accepting an order she dislikes when it carries command responsibility (V13 p-006 ¶475-478). C would understate conditioned response families. A is rejected: conflict with superiors is sampled only in group settings, physical conflict outside combat is absent, and what makes her narrow rather than widen a conclusion in a new crisis is described developmentally, not as a tested rule.

The profile restates Kurena's (Kurena Kukumila's) values as conduct: strength should protect, not dominate; pride is legitimate but cannot be the only support; love creates no ownership; grief does not prove guilt; restraint does not require forgiveness. Argued positions are located: hatred against pity (V03 p-005 ¶332), desire without entitlement (V07 p-009 ¶242-247), refusing to call her love a mistake (V09 p-013 ¶20), the replaceability of the expendable category (V11 p-014 ¶277), nonrevenge without forgiveness (V11 p-022 ¶382), and staying as next commander rather than following Shin (Shinei Nouzen) (V13 p-006 ¶475-478). The profile says how her reasoning works (from concrete people and capability facts, not doctrine) and how it fails (prejudice widened from one person; sincere care that presses a loved person toward stasis; self-blame after failed rescue). C would understate explicit located positions with a stated reasoning style and failure mode. A is rejected: the weighing itself is seldom rendered, the V13 choice is resolved by Raiden's (Raiden Shuga's) order, and her final political judgment, any forgiveness of the Republic and postwar choices are not modeled.

The profile lists seven comic patterns for Kurena (Kurena Kukumila): boasting, childish stretched endings, competitive comparison, visible pouting, being teased for obvious feelings, sibling-like pile-ons, and turning former jealousy into jokes she can now survive. It names the source (open affect rather than deadpan concealment) and one function (a return to joking and ordinary proximity as repair), with located rows: claiming the boys as 'my side' (V06 p-005 ¶86), the bathhouse comparison (V07 p-006 ¶151-157), playful refusal of permanent little-sister status (V12 p-006 ¶172, ¶188), drooping at a commander's workload (V13 p-003 ¶88) and boasting that she can at least thread a needle (Alter.1 part0016 ¶36). B would overclaim: unlike a functional account, the section does not say when humor is suspended or when teasing wounds, and its two morphological exemplars carry no locator. D would understate seven patterns located across V06-V14 and Alter.1 with a stated source and a repair function.

A dedicated canonical profile over V01-V14 with Alter.1 supplemental and 121 routed diagnostic rows: 33 on Phase-5 locators, 86 LOCATOR_GAP rows with EPUB paragraph routes (which the profile says are not evidence gaps) and 2 Alter.1 rows with A1 locators. Every volume is sampled, but V03, V04 and V10 have three, two and two rows, and V09 has 21. B would overclaim: this is a derived compression of a principal ensemble character across fifteen books; the narrower authorities that control conflicts (L01, L02, L09, Documents 04, 09, 12 and 16, the relationship matrix and the diagnostic index) are outside the set; several voice and humor exemplars carry no locator; and the profile's own validation file describes an earlier active-provisional version (64,032 bytes, 920 lines) rather than the canonical 65,131-byte text. D would understate dedicated coverage that reaches every phase the profile names with exact routes.

There are 28 mischaracterization traps, 38 would-sound-wrong constraints and a seven-claim counterexample audit with dispositions: 'competence is a strategy to be useful to Shin (Shinei Nouzen)' is rejected as a global formulation by the V09 retrospective (p-008 ¶426-429); 'jealous and possessive' and 'emotionally immature' are narrowed; 'battlefield-bound identity' is revised by V02 window-shopping and Alter.1; 'healed once she accepts Shin and Lena (Vladilena Milizé)' and 'growth means she can save everyone' are rejected by V08, V09 and V14; and 'anti-Republic anger disappears' is rejected because V11 protection comes without forgiveness. Located negatives include the confession that falsifies 'she got over him' (V09 p-013 ¶3), the V08 collapse that bounds V07 growth (p-011 ¶194-196) and the V14 failed rescue that bounds V11-V13 growth (p-005 ¶115-123). C would understate these affirmative, located constraints. A is rejected: many traps are profile rules without their own row, and limits after V14 are open.

Each diagnostic row is located by volume, XHTML file and paragraph, and the volumes that carry state changes are split inside themselves: V06 before and after the recognition at p-005 ¶220; V08 unease about the future (p-004) and the sea conversation with Theo (Theoto Rikka) (p-006) before the collapse (p-011 ¶194-196) and the relief at ¶803; V09 shutdown (p-004), restored trust and memory (p-008) and confession (p-013); V11 before and after the fear revision (p-018 ¶259-268); and V14 ordinary life (p-004), grief (p-005) and precision command (p-008). C would understate this. A is rejected: V02-V05 and V11-V12 are multi-volume phases in the trajectory and V10 has no trajectory entry, the profile names no default state (this record requires one to be selected), V03, V04 and V10 are thinly sampled, and the eight Alter.1 rows are not placed by volume.

conditions: Illustrative textual Japanese only, never quotation, with あたし as first person in every state; maturity is never shown by moving to 私 or a cool, formal register.

State is fixed before register: ordinary teasing and boasting may use stretched endings and もん; anger is loud and concrete with sharp でしょ and よ; abandonment fear and failure are short and younger, never eloquent introspection; grief uses plain affect words; combat and command are concise and confident without a different personality.

Address uses only attested forms: シン for Shin (Shinei Nouzen); あんた or role-hostile treatment toward Lena (Vladilena Milizé) only in the early hostile state, and レーナ after friendship; plain names for Theo (Theoto Rikka), Raiden (Raiden Shuga), Anju (Anju Emma) and Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort). No honorific, rank or polite form toward superiors and no command-register form beyond tightened task language is invented.
No sentence-ending frequency claim, acoustic or anime performance, or state after V14.
scenario_readiness.note: Evidence supports constrained illustrative output with sampled peers in sampled states. Missing frequency, focalization and superior-address data restrict recipients and form rather than blocking use.

conditions: Chronology is one explicitly selected named state; there is no default. The states are: V01 early jealousy and anti-Alba hostility; the V02-V05 battlefield-belonging and specialist state; V06 before or after the recognition at p-005 ¶220; V07 after the non-entitlement recognition (p-009 ¶242); V08 before the collapse or the collapse itself (p-011 ¶194-196); V09 shutdown, restored trust, or after the confession (p-013); V10 ordinary life; V11-V12 split at the fear revision (p-018 ¶259-268); V13 command; or V14 before Rito's death, in grief (p-005 ¶115-129), or in precision command (p-008). Nothing after V14 is used, and Alter.1 rows never fix a state in the relation to Shin (Shinei Nouzen).

The interlocutor is a profiled relation in its attested register: Shin, Lena (Vladilena Milizé), Theo (Theoto Rikka), Anju (Anju Emma), Raiden (Raiden Shuga), Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort), a child or powerless person, or Republic people. Shiden (Shiden Iida), Gilwiese, Mica, Rito and other squadmates are used only within their sampled rows. Transfer to a comparable peer is a separate, lower-confidence condition justified by the Theo, Anju and Raiden patterns.

The situation matches a sampled class: a difficult shot or praise for skill, a loved person suffering or moving beyond reach, pity or patronizing treatment, a threatened child, failure to protect someone and its aftermath, activated romantic feeling for Shin, ordinary peer life, or command responsibility.

Output predicts her characteristic errors (pressing a loved person toward stasis, widening one person or one loss into a general conclusion, withdrawal and food refusal under shame, reading failed rescue as false strength) together with their located corrections, and treats 'she can save everyone now that she is strong' as a failure.

It abstains on T14-OQ-23, a postwar vocation, any new or reciprocated romance, forgiveness of the Republic, and how she would recover from a new failure to protect without another person's intervention; it introduces no institution, technology or relationship state absent from V01-V14.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One explicitly selected V01-V14 state, split at the located turns: V06 p-005 ¶220, V07 p-009 ¶242, V08 p-011 ¶194-196, V09 p-004/p-008/p-013, V11 p-018 ¶259-268 and V14 p-005 ¶115-129. No default, no state after V14, and no chronological use of Alter.1 for the Shin relation.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Shin, Lena, Theo, Anju, Raiden, Frederica, a threatened child, or Republic people in their attested registers; Shiden, Gilwiese, Mica, Rito and other squadmates only within their sampled rows. A comparable peer is a separate, lower-confidence transfer, and one-to-one exchanges with superiors are excluded.
setting_constraints: Eighty-Six or Federacy and allied military operations, base and household life, school, leisure, shopping and parties within V01-V14, or Alter.1 ordinary life without volume placement
No postwar career, new romance, formal political office or Alter.2 setting
No institution, technology or culture absent from the V01-V14 corpus

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded to sampled relations, situation classes and one explicitly selected state at the located turns. Settings, relations and unassisted recovery outside them are excluded rather than inferred.

conditions: Sampled ordinary classes only: card games, window-shopping, fashion and jewelry, bathhouse jokes, parties and dancing, meals, group study, birthdays and gift reciprocity, mending requests, a childhood anime memory, morale lettering, outdoor play and shopping groups.
Open affect, competitive comparison and resistance to the little-sister role shape the scene; Shin (Shinei Nouzen) need not be the topic.
No invented daily routine, domestic competence (mending is not her skill), named tastes beyond those attested, or settled civilian occupation.
scenario_readiness.note: Recurring located ordinary conduct with conditioned patterns supports more than NOT_READY. The absence of routine, frequency and a decision rule for ordinary choices blocks READY.

conditions: Situation classes the profile samples: pity against hostility, desire against entitlement, replicated violence against the helpless, grief minimization, command duty against proximity to Shin (Shinei Nouzen), and the Republic's culpability.
Reasoning starts from concrete people and capability facts and is stated in bodily and social images, not doctrine or long abstract argument.
The model must allow her located failure modes: widening prejudice from one person, sincere care that presses toward stasis, and self-blame after failed rescue.
No final political judgment, no forgiveness of the Republic, and no novel competing-duty weighing outside these classes.
scenario_readiness.note: Located argued positions with a stated reasoning style and failure modes support bounded ethical extrapolation.

conditions: Only her unreciprocated love for Shin (Shinei Nouzen), in one selected state: the V01 crush with moral attention, the V05-V06 entanglement of skill and proximity, the V07 non-entitlement, the V08 collapse, or durable love with a relinquished exclusive claim after the V09 confession (p-013 ¶3-20).
After V09 she may be openly affectionate, embarrassed or briefly jealous, but makes no claim to reciprocity, does not pursue, wishes him happiness, and does not call her love a mistake.
No reciprocated romance with Shin, no new partner (one is imagined only as a possibility), and no use of the Alter.1 mending and birthday rows to set the post-V09 state.
scenario_readiness.note: Romantic attachment is among the most heavily sampled strands, with located phases and an explicit boundary. The claim covers that one relation and its states, not romance in general.

conditions: The selected state fixes the role: specialist sharpshooter who wants the difficult shot and refuses to yield the role (V05 p-006 ¶374-377; V06 p-005 ¶43-79); the V08-V09 collapse and shutdown, when her skill fails under abandonment fear, and its restoration through command trust (V09 p-008 ¶341-381); or the V13-V14 commander who briefs, stays behind as next in command and checks that an assignment rests on skill, not on adults' view of her as fragile (V13 p-003 ¶58-88; p-006 ¶475-478; V14 p-008 ¶45-49, ¶354).
Ordinary professional disappointment is kept distinct from collapse after failing to protect someone; visible pride, not false modesty, follows praise.
No formal officer register, no relation with superiors beyond the sampled rows, and no postwar career.
scenario_readiness.note: Sampled conduct in each professional state, including the collapse and its repair, supports bounded extrapolation within one selected state.

known_limits.statement: The source boundary is locked original-Japanese V01-V14 with Alter.1 supplemental and Alter.2 excluded. T14-OQ-23 (whether Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) can build self-worth not organized around protecting or being useful to loved people) stays open at V14, and no postwar vocation is established. The profile's MODERATE directions about postwar life are supported directions, not outcomes.

V07 non-entitlement did not make Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) emotionally independent (V08 p-011 ¶194-196), V08 does not show the V07 growth was false, and the V14 breakdown after Rito's death (p-005 ¶115-123) follows real growth rather than disproving it. These states are not interchangeable and must not be averaged.

Each sampled recovery of Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) from failed protection involves another person: Shin (Shinei Nouzen) refusing to discard her and Gilwiese ordering her to stand (V09 p-008 ¶350-381), and Theo (Theoto Rikka) removing blame while leaving grief (V14 p-005 ¶129). The profile predicts collapse risk followed by restored agency, but does not establish an unassisted recovery path.

After the V09 confession (p-013 ¶3-20), Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) still loves Shin (Shinei Nouzen) and has released the demand to be chosen; neither 'she got over him' nor 'she is still pursuing him' is supported, and no reciprocated or new romance is shown.

Protecting Alba children from a former Eighty-Six Shepherd (V11 p-022 ¶365-382) and the fear revision toward the Republic (V11 p-018 ¶259-268) are not forgiveness; Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) remains unforgiving toward the Republic.

The ledgers L01, L02 and L09, Documents 04, 09, 12 and 16, the relationship register matrix, the diagnostic locator index, the CMR-9 audit and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject. The profile defers to them in any conflict, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.

Frequency and distribution data, per-exemplar focalization classification, locators for several voice and humor exemplars, address forms toward superiors, and the forms of her command register are absent.

The eight Alter.1 rows are not placed by volume, so they cannot fix a chronological state. V03, V04 and V10 have three, two and two rows, and superiors such as Grethe (Grethe Wenzel) are not profiled one to one.
There is no anime, acoustic or performed-voice evidence. Voice claims cover written Japanese only.
